name: Survey tile in Capricornus
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 0.5 degrees north of the ecliptic in Capricornus, imaged by SPHEREx 10 times in 4 visits over 39 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 22 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 39 hours starting 2025-04-29, at wavelengths from 1.10 to 4.39 µm. The pipeline found 2 moving objects.
